verifiedDesc: Dieses Projekt wurde einer vollständigen Sicherheitsprüfung durch MeowLab unterzogen. Der Open-Source-Code ist nachweislich frei von Schadsoftware und Account-Diebstahl. Diesem Produkt kann zu 100% vertraut werden.
privacyModalText: 1. No User Database or Tracking: MeowLab (meowlab.fun) is an open non-commercial catalog with no site accounts, ad trackers, or data selling. 2. Public Interaction: reviews, [rating](0-100) scores, danger reports, translations, Discussions, and project proposals work via public GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg Issues (as well as 1-click Discord reviews). 3. Browser Storage (localStorage / sessionStorage): used strictly for theme preference, language choice (13 languages), project comparison selection, and caching Fluffies.
termsModalText: 1. Open Catalog (Global Alpha): MeowLab (meowlab.fun, with a 301 redirect from meowlab.pp.ua) and the i10n ecosystem (translations and open-source Zig desktop app) are open-source under GPL-3.0. 2. Disclaimer: The catalog is provided as-is based on public sources (GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg) and community reviews. Always verify official download links. 3. Contact: Discord (discord.com/invite/FEyMjn3mtA), email baneronetwo@memeware.net, or GitHub Issues.
expensesSubtitle: MeowLab ist ein offenes, nicht-kommerzielles Community-Projekt. Wir veröffentlichen alle Ausgaben und Ziele.
nextGoalDesc: New fundraiser for the i10n tab: Minecraft launcher & mod translations, a fast open-source desktop app written in Zig, community localization tools, and much more.
futureGoalDesc: Long-term domain renewals, expanded infrastructure, interactive translation hub, and new open-source tools for players and creators.
confidentialityModalText: 1. Public Submissions: All proposals, malware/scam reports, comments, and translations submitted via GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, or 1-click Discord are public and synced across catalog mirrors. Never post passwords, session tokens, or third-party personal data. 2. Report Verification: Evidence in danger reports is reviewed by admins before applying the DANGEROUS badge. 3. Funding Transparency: ARCHIVED and SPONSOR badges as well as community fundraisers (including the completed meowlab.fun domain and active i10n goal) are published openly in the Expenses tab.

verifyCriterion1: Open-Source-Code auf GitHub ohne schädliche Obfuskation.
verifyCriterion2: Keine versteckte Erfassung von Passwörtern, Tokens oder Spielerdaten.
verifyCriterion3: Sichere Algorithmen zum Herunterladen von Bibliotheken und Spieldateien.
verifyCriterion4: Einwandfreier Ruf unter unabhängigen Entwicklern der Minecraft-Community.
privacyClause2Body: MeowLab is hosted on Cloudflare Workers + Assets with a strict Content Security Policy (CSP). Cloudflare and open mirrors (GitHub / GitLab / Codeberg) may process technical HTTP headers solely for DDoS protection, caching, HTTPS delivery, and cookie-free aggregate traffic analytics.
privacyClause3Body: Minecraft server status is queried directly from your browser via the public mcstatus.io API without sending personal identifiers. Repository stars (GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, Gitea), latest GitHub Releases, and YouTube channel stats (subscribers / LIVE status) are synced automatically into static JSON files.
confClause1Head: 01 // Public GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg & Discord Reviews
confClause2Body: Stellen Sie beim Melden schädlicher Software sicher, dass Screenshots und Logs keine persönlichen Auth-Tokens oder vertraulichen Daten enthalten.
termsClause2Body: Descriptions, repository stars, GitHub Release changelogs, side-by-side comparison tables, and media are published for informational purposes for the Minecraft community. All copyrights and trademarks belong to their respective developers.
termsClause3Body: A legitimate rights holder or user may request updates or removal of an entry or review via GitHub Issues, GitLab, Codeberg, Discord (discord.com/invite/FEyMjn3mtA), or baneronetwo@memeware.net.
reportStep1Desc: Beschreiben Sie das Problem in beliebiger Sprache (bis zu 20.000 Zeichen in Markdown): Malware, Token-Stealer, Betrug.

reportStep3Desc: Die Meldung wird als GitHub Issue erstellt. Ein Bot öffnet automatisch einen Pull Request zur Prüfung.
reportStep4Desc: Nach Bestätigung durch einen Admin erscheint das Label GEFÄHRLICH mit Ihrer Begründung.

privacyClause4Body: When posting a review with Discord, only the minimal identify scope (public display name, avatar, and user ID) is requested — no access to email, servers, messages, or passwords. Your draft is HMAC-SHA256 signed in a short-lived 10-minute HttpOnly/Secure cookie (ml_review_draft) and deleted immediately after publishing. The Discord access token is revoked right away and no long-lived sessions are stored. Anti-spam checks require a Discord account at least 14 days old (derived from ID), enforce 1 Discord account = 1 review per project, and publish the comment publicly to GitHub Issues via the BanikikikikiAI bot account.
confClause3Body: Submitting a new Discord review for the same project automatically updates your previous comment and rating. To permanently delete your Discord review from the public GitHub Issue, contact us on Discord or via baneronetwo@memeware.net.
